response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, highly experienced software craftsman with a strong background in TypeScript, DLang, and full-stack web development, but his resume shows minimal direct experience with Java/Kotlin, no Spring/Quarkus/Hibernate exposure, and no evident IDE internals or language tooling background — all core requirements for this role. While he has some Java exposure (robotic arms project, C IDE work at National Instruments) and clearly deep technical skill, the lack of enterprise JVM ecosystem depth makes him a poor match for this specific role.
strengths: Extensive, diverse software engineering experience across many languages and platforms
Demonstrated ability to own complex systems end-to-end and work with high-performance/low-latency architectures
Strong communication and teaching skills (workshops, talks, open source)
concerns: No recent or substantial experience with Java/Kotlin in an enterprise context
No mention of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or JVM application server tooling
No evidence of IDE internals, language tooling, or compiler/plugin development experience

key_factors.factor: Lack of Spring/enterprise JVM framework experience
No IDE internals or language tooling background
Strong general engineering craftsmanship and adaptability
